scientific_integrity: The computation uses exact integer chunks in base \(3^{39}\), an exact necessary prefix/suffix filter, and full exact digit comparison for every filter survivor. No floating-point or probabilistic inference is used.
scientific_limitations: Finite verification only: the conjecture is checked for \(1\le n\le10^6\), not proved for all exponents. An unindexed computation may have checked a larger range.
title: Kreher--Stinson conjecture (e) verified through \(n=10^6\)
